infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MeepleUp needs access to your photo library to let you select photos for your profile picture and to share photos in group discussions. For example, you can choose a photo from your library to use as your profile picture, or select a photo to share with other members in your private game group's discussion.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MeepleUp needs permission to save photos to your photo library. For example, you can choose to save photos shared in group discussions to your library for future reference.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow MeepleUp to access your microphone to record audio narration when taking photos of games.

plugins.cameraPermission: MeepleUp needs access to your camera to take photos of board games for AI-powered identification. For example, you can take a photo of a board game box and the app will use AI to identify the game and add it to your collection automatically.
